question: Which Yoga pose makes you stand tall and steady like a strong mountain? ⛰️
explanation: Awesome! Tadasana is also known as the Mountain Pose. It helps you stand tall, straight, and strong like a big mountain! ⛰️
hint: It is named after a very tall rock formation.

question: What is the best time of the day to practice yoga? 🌅
explanation: Great job! Early morning is the best time for yoga because the air is fresh and your mind is very calm! 🌅
hint: It is when the sun just comes up.

question: Which pose helps improve your balance by standing on one leg like a tree? 🌳
explanation: Super! The Tree pose (Vrikshasana) teaches you how to balance and stay focused like a strong tree! 🌳

question: What do we call the deep breathing exercises in yoga? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! Pranayama means controlling your breath. It fills your lungs with fresh air and energy! 🌬️

question: Which body part do we use to breathe in and out during Pranayama? 👃
explanation: Great job! We should always take deep, slow breaths through our nose while doing yoga! 👃
hint: It is right in the middle of your face.

question: How should you sit when you do meditation or breathing exercises? 🪑
explanation: Super! Keeping a straight back helps the air flow easily into your lungs! 📏

question: Which pose looks like a beautiful lotus flower? 🪷
explanation: Awesome! Padmasana is the Lotus pose. You sit cross-legged peacefully like a beautiful flower! 🪷

question: What is the relaxing pose we do at the very end of yoga? 🛌
explanation: Great job! Shavasana (Corpse pose) lets your whole body rest and relax completely after yoga! 🛌
hint: You lie flat on your back and close your eyes.

question: Which breathing exercise sounds like a buzzing bee? 🐝
explanation: Super! In Bhramari Pranayama, we make a soft humming sound just like a happy little bee! 🐝
hint: Think of the insect that makes honey.

question: What should we put on the floor before starting our yoga practice? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! A soft yoga mat keeps you safe and comfortable while stretching on the floor! 🔲
hint: It is soft and you roll it up.

question: Which animal pose makes you stretch your back upward like a kitty? 🐈
explanation: Great job! Marjaryasana is the Cat pose. It gives your back a really nice and gentle stretch! 🐈

question: What kind of clothes are best to wear while doing yoga? 👕
explanation: Super! Loose and comfortable clothes help you bend, stretch, and move very easily! 👕
hint: Clothes that are soft and stretchy.

question: What do we do to prepare our body before starting yoga poses? 🤸
explanation: Awesome! Gentle warm-up exercises wake up your muscles and make them ready for yoga! 🤸
hint: It gets your body moving slightly.

question: Yoga helps to make our mind feel what? 🧠
explanation: Great job! Deep breathing and yoga poses relax your brain and make you feel very peaceful! 😌
hint: The opposite of noisy and angry.

question: Which pose makes you look like a cobra snake lifting its head? 🐍
explanation: Super! Bhujangasana is the Cobra pose. You lie on your tummy and lift your chest high! 🐍

question: How should your stomach feel before practicing yoga? 🍽️
explanation: Awesome! Doing yoga on a light or empty stomach feels much better and is very healthy! 🍽️
hint: Don't eat a big meal right before.

question: Which yoga pose is also known as the Diamond pose? 💎
explanation: Great job! Vajrasana is the Diamond pose. Sitting in this pose helps digest your food nicely! 💎
hint: It is named after a precious, shiny stone.

question: Taking fresh air into your lungs is called what? 🌬️
explanation: Super! Inhaling means taking a deep breath in to fill your lungs with fresh oxygen! 🌬️

question: Letting the air out of your lungs is called what? 💨
explanation: Awesome! Exhaling is when you gently blow the used air out of your nose! 💨

question: What is the very quiet time where we sit and focus our mind called? 🧘
explanation: Great job! Meditation is sitting quietly, closing your eyes, and letting your mind rest! 🧘

question: What pose looks like a happy baby resting? 👶
explanation: Super! Balasana is the Child's pose. It stretches your back and helps you feel safe and cozy! 👶
hint: It is named after a young kid.

question: Yoga is originally from which beautiful country? 🇮🇳
explanation: Awesome! Yoga started in India thousands of years ago and is now loved all over the world! 🇮🇳

question: Which pose makes your legs flap gently like wings? 🦋
explanation: Great job! Baddha Konasana is the Butterfly pose. Flapping your legs gently stretches your hips! 🦋
hint: A colorful insect that flies in gardens.

question: Doing daily yoga makes our muscles what? 💪
explanation: Super! Stretching every day makes your muscles strong, stretchy, and super healthy! 💪

question: How should we behave while learning yoga? 🙏
explanation: Awesome! Being calm and focused helps you learn the poses safely and perfectly! 🙏

question: What shape does your body make in Trikonasana? 🔺
explanation: Great job! Trikonasana is the Triangle pose. You stretch your arms and legs to look like a triangle! 🔺

question: Yoga is good for your body and your what? 🧠
explanation: Super! Yoga exercises your body and helps your mind stay happy and smart! 🧠

question: Which pose requires you to roar and stick your tongue out? 🦁
explanation: Awesome! Simhasana is the Lion pose. It is a fun way to release tension by roaring like a lion! 🦁

question: What is the series of steps we do to say 'Hello' to the sun? ☀️
explanation: Great job! Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation) is a wonderful set of poses to start your day with energy! ☀️

question: Breathing slowly and deeply helps our heart do what? ❤️
explanation: Super! Deep breaths signal your body to calm down, making your heart happy and relaxed! ❤️

question: Which posture bends your back backwards like a shooting bow? 🏹
explanation: Awesome! Dhanurasana is the Bow pose. You hold your ankles and bend like a bow! 🏹
hint: You use it to shoot an arrow.

question: What should you do if a yoga pose hurts? 🛑
explanation: Great job! Yoga should never hurt. Always listen to your body and rest if you need to! 🛑

question: Anulom Vilom is an exercise for your what? 👃
explanation: Super! Anulom Vilom is a special Pranayama where we breathe cleanly through different nostrils! 👃

question: Which hand gesture means 'I respect you' in yoga? 🙏
explanation: Awesome! Pressing your hands together in Namaste shows deep respect and love! 🙏

question: Which animal pose involves stretching your arms forward and pushing your hips back? 🐕
explanation: Great job! The Downward-Facing Dog pose gives your whole body a fantastic stretch! 🐕

question: What does closing your eyes during meditation help you do? 😌
explanation: Super! Closing your eyes helps you look inward, relax, and focus your busy mind! 😌

question: Daily yoga practice helps us sleep like what at night? 🛌
explanation: Awesome! Yoga relaxes your muscles so you can sleep deeply and peacefully like a happy baby! 🛌

question: Which pose makes you sit on your heels like a strong warrior? 🦸
explanation: Great job! Sitting on your heels in Vajrasana keeps your spine perfectly straight and strong! 🦸

question: What happens when you hold a balancing pose for a long time? ⚖️
explanation: Super! Balancing requires focus, and it makes your leg muscles very strong! 💪

question: Drinking plenty of what is good after doing yoga? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Water hydrates your body and helps wash away all the tiredness! 💧

question: What part of your body do you stretch in the Cobra pose? 🐍
explanation: Great job! Arching up like a cobra stretches your chest and makes your back flexible! 🦴

question: Doing yoga regularly keeps away what? 🦠
explanation: Super! Yoga boosts your immunity, keeping you healthy, strong, and away from illness! 🦠
hint: When you catch a cold or fever.

question: Which pose is named after a large animal that lives in the desert? 🐪
explanation: Awesome! Ustrasana is the Camel pose. It is a wonderful backbend that opens up your chest! 🐪
hint: It has humps on its back.

question: Breathing out all your air slowly helps to remove what? 💨
explanation: Great job! Long exhales help push out old, stale air (carbon dioxide) from your lungs! 💨
hint: The carbon dioxide your body doesn't need.

question: In which pose do you balance on your tummy like a boat? ⛵
explanation: Super! Navasana is the Boat pose. You lift your legs and chest to make a sturdy 'V' shape! ⛵

question: What is the best way to end your yoga session? 🙏
explanation: Awesome! Saying 'Namaste' shows respect and gratitude to your teacher and yourself! 🙏

question: Which body part does the Tree pose help make stronger? 🦵
explanation: Great job! Standing on one foot builds incredible strength and balance in your legs! 🦵

question: The word 'Yoga' means to do what? 🤝
explanation: Super! Yoga means to unite or join. It connects your body, your breath, and your mind! 🤝

question: How should you feel when you finally master a hard yoga pose? 😊
explanation: Awesome! Achieving a hard pose takes practice, so you should feel proud and very happy! 😄
hint: A big smile on your face.

question: What is the most important thing to remember while doing yoga? 🧘
explanation: Great job! Smooth, continuous breathing is the secret to a perfect and relaxing yoga practice! 🌬️
